lines.trans: Next up, here is a clean signed copy of our Courtyard Waltz and four-hand duet score.
And from Hao and me: birch clothespin number nine, signed across the back by everyone!
Oh, look what our Room Eight mapmaker sent in with Teacher Song to crown the box!
While we were playing piano, he sketched all twenty-eight of us under the lanterns in charcoal!
Look at Chen in the charcoal sketch standing by the doorway pretending not to smile!
Tuck a small packet of dried courtyard mint leaves into the corner for a fresh scent.
Thirty years from now, someone will lift this lid and smell warm summer tea.
Lid pressed snug, white cloth tape wrapped around the rim—ready for the yellow waxed cloth!
Let us carry it out under the lanterns while the third stone is still waiting!

examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

meanings.en: four-hand piano duet played together on one keyboard
meanings.note: Pinyin: sì shǒu lián tán. Literally 'four hands linked playing,' naming two pianists sharing one piano bench.

examples.text: 下午四点我和宋老师把四手联弹钢琴曲最后排练一遍！
examples.trans: And at four this afternoon Song and I run through our four-hand piano duet one last time!

examples.text: 只剩三个小时了！蛋糕还只是面糊，四手联弹也只排了一半！
examples.trans: Only three hours left! The cakes are still batter, and the duet is only half rehearsed!

meanings.note: Pinyin: quān. Counts full turns of a key, wrench, or lap around a block (一圈 'one full turn').

examples.text: 一圈，两圈……看新铜螺纹咬合得多干净。
examples.trans: One turn, two turns... look how cleanly the new brass thread fits.

examples.text: 我绕着广场走了一圈。
examples.trans: I walked one lap around the square.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

块.gloss: measure word for pieces and yuan

meanings.en: measure word for pieces and yuan
meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. Counts chunks/pieces (一块蛋糕 'a piece of cake') and spoken yuan of money (五块钱 'five yuan').

examples.text: 钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
examples.trans: Here is fifty yuan from the cash box; remember to get a receipt!

examples.text: 在这儿！一共三十八块，找回十二块零钱。
examples.trans: Right here! Thirty-eight yuan in total, with twelve yuan back in change.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sù fēng. Combines 塑 ('plastic') + 封 ('seal'); often used attributively (塑封卡片 'laminated card').

examples.text: 老陈，你账本里夹着的那张塑封卡片是什么？
examples.trans: Chen, what is that laminated card tucked inside your ledger?

examples.text: 小晴把新印好的咖啡馆菜单塑封起来，就不怕茶水弄湿了。
examples.trans: Qing laminated the newly printed café menus so spilled tea cannot get them wet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sāi. Used for slipping a note into an envelope or plugging a gap.

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

examples.text: 快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
examples.trans: Fold up that sheet of paper right now and tuck it into your pocket.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià. Short literary and compound root for 夏天, appearing in seasonal nouns like 夏茶 (summer tea) or 初夏 (early summer).

examples.text: 三十年后，有人掀开这个盖子，就会闻见暖暖的夏茶香。
examples.trans: Thirty years from now, someone will lift this lid and smell warm summer tea.

examples.text: 每到初夏，院子那棵大梧桐树就能替整排餐桌挡住午后烈日。
examples.trans: Every early summer, the big courtyard wutong tree shades the whole row of tables from the midday sun.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个夏天 ('a summer').

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

examples.text: 夏天坐在大树底下乘凉最舒服。
examples.trans: Sitting in the shade beneath the big tree in summer is bliss.

meanings.note: Warm erhua form of 大伙.

examples.text: 这件事连累了您，大伙儿心里都过意不去。
examples.trans: Dragging you into this left everybody feeling bad.

examples.text: 天色不早了，大伙儿赶紧收拾东西回家吧。
examples.trans: It is getting late—everybody pack up and head home.

meanings.note: Prefix/noun tóu ('first, initial; head').

examples.text: 开篇的头一句就是道可道。
examples.trans: The very first line at the opening is Dao Ke Dao.

examples.text: 这是我头一回进大型演播室。
examples.trans: This is my very first time inside a major TV studio.

子.gloss: nominal suffix (forming everyday nouns like 桌子, 椅子, 盘子)

meanings.en: nominal suffix (forming everyday nouns like 桌子, 椅子, 盘子)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zi. Neutral-tone noun suffix attached to roots such as 桌 ('table'), 椅 ('chair'), 盘 ('plate'), and 罐 ('jar').

examples.text: 晚上和周末，我们一起做木桌子和隔音木板！
examples.trans: Evenings and weekends, we are building wooden tables and acoustic panels together!

examples.text: 院子里的木桌子和竹椅子都已经擦得干干净净了。
examples.trans: The wooden tables and bamboo chairs in the courtyard have all been wiped spotless.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个字 ('a written character').

examples.text: 真好奇！那张行李牌上的字看着很眼熟。
examples.trans: How curious! The handwriting on that tag looked very familiar.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

meanings.en: unabridged or complete edition with all parts reunited
meanings.note: Pinyin: wán zhéng bǎn. Combines 完整 (intact, whole) with 版 (edition, version).

examples.text: 头一样放进盒子里的是完整版浆果杏仁蛋糕方子——上下两半合璧啦！
examples.trans: First into the box goes the complete berry almond cake recipe—both halves reunited!

examples.text: 宋老师把完整版的梧桐巷钢琴谱仔细折好放进乐谱夹。
examples.trans: Song neatly folded the complete edition of the Wutong Lane piano score into her music folder.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo. Everyday adjective for small size; also prefixes younger colleagues' names warmly (小晴, 小美).

examples.text: 早上好，姑娘。我有一个宋名下的预订。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I have a booking for Song.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo yuàn. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座小院 ('a small courtyard').

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块布 ('a piece of cloth').

examples.text: 周经理，给您干净布和冷水。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, here is a clean cloth and cold water for you.

examples.text: 请拿一块干净的布擦桌子。
examples.trans: Please take a clean cloth to wipe the table.

related.gloss: a piece of cloth (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: dài. Used for carrying keys, tools, or luggage with you.

examples.text: 这么快就修好了？老陈你随身带着螺丝刀啊！
examples.trans: Fixed that fast? Chen, you carry a screwdriver everywhere on you!

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
examples.trans: Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐ xia. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最底下 ('the bottom').

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

examples.text: 前面锁扣有个小锁孔，再看底下贴着：一把旧铜钥匙！
examples.trans: There is a tiny keyhole on the front latch, and taped underneath: an old brass key!

张.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

meanings.en: measure word for flat surfaces and paper
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāng. Counts tables, beds, paper sheets, tickets, receipts, and luggage tags (一张桌子, 一张纸).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tán qín. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 宋老师？！每星期五教我哥哥弹琴的宋老师？！
examples.trans: Teacher Song?! The Teacher Song who taught my brother piano every Friday?!

examples.text: 每天下午她都在窗边安静地弹琴。
examples.trans: Every afternoon she plays the piano quietly by the window.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì háo. Given name of Zhipeng's older brother, an acoustic architect.

examples.text: 没关系！您就是志豪先生吧？
examples.trans: No problem at all! You must be Mr Zhihao, right?

examples.text: 是的，我叫志豪。昨天打电话订了七号房。
examples.trans: Yes, my name is Zhihao. Yesterday I booked room seven by phone.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

托.gloss: to entrust; ask someone to deliver

meanings.en: to entrust a message or task to someone; to support on one's palm
meanings.note: Pinyin: tuō. In 托某人做某事, means 'ask someone on one's behalf to carry or handle something.'

examples.text: 哎呀，快看八号房制图老先生托宋老师带进来压轴的东西！
examples.trans: Oh, look what our Room Eight mapmaker sent in with Teacher Song to crown the box!

examples.text: 因为市政文化遗产办公室托我把一封正式公函留到今晚再拿出来！
examples.trans: Because the Municipal Heritage Office asked me to hold one official letter until tonight!

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

掀开.gloss: lift open; fold back (a flap, lid, or cloth)

meanings.en: lift open; fold back (a flap, lid, or cloth)
meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān kāi. Resultative verb joining 掀 ('lift a cover or corner') + 开 ('open').

examples.text: 先掀开左边蜡布，再掀开右边，里面的红金铁盒就露出来了！
examples.trans: Fold back the left flap of waxed cloth, then the right, and out gleams the red-and-gold tin box!

examples.text: 小美轻轻掀开蒸笼盖子，热腾腾的甜香飘满厨房。
examples.trans: Mei gently lifted the steamer lid, filling the kitchen with warm sweet fragrance.

meanings.en: next; after this; in the next step
meanings.note: Pronounced jiē xiàlái; used sentence-initially as a discourse connector (especially by hosts and directors) or before 的 + noun ('the upcoming...').

examples.text: 接下来抓紧时间，把最终稿交上来。
examples.trans: Next, make good use of the time and hand in the final draft.

examples.text: 女士们，先生们，接下来有请今晚的神秘嘉宾！
examples.trans: Ladies and gentlemen, up next please welcome tonight's mystery guest!

meanings.note: Pinyin: fàng. Everyday verb for placing an object somewhere (放在桌子上).

examples.text: 我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
examples.trans: We do not know. Someone set it on the step and rang the bell.

examples.text: 小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

examples.text: 感觉非常好，还要谢谢方老师推荐。
examples.trans: It feels great, and I also want to thank Professor Fang for the recommendation.

examples.text: 院子正中央摆着一张擦得发亮的老榆木方桌。
examples.trans: Right in the center of the courtyard sits a gleaming old elmwood square table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

晒干.gloss: to sun-dry; dry in the sun

meanings.en: to dry completely in warm sunlight
meanings.note: Pinyin: shài gān. Joins 晒 (expose to the sun) with result complement 干 (dry).

examples.text: 角落里再塞一小包晒干的院子薄荷叶，留点清香。
examples.trans: Tuck a small packet of dried courtyard mint leaves into the corner for a fresh scent.

examples.text: 下午太阳正好，周经理把那张水彩海报摊在石凳上晒干。
examples.trans: With the afternoon sun shining bright, Zhou spread the watercolor poster on a stone bench to dry.

meanings.en: smudging or feathering of ink into paper fibers
meanings.note: Pinyin: yùn mò. Combines 晕 (yùn, spread in a halo) with 墨 (mò, ink), key in calligraphy and archival paper.

examples.text: 三十个夏天后的烘焙师值得一张不晕墨、也不沾菜汤的方子！
examples.trans: Bakers thirty summers from tonight deserve a recipe with zero smudged ink and zero soup drips!

examples.text: 因为担心钢笔纸张容易晕墨，小晴这次改用深色木工铅笔写编号。
examples.trans: Worried that fountain-pen ink might bleed, Qing switched to a dark carpenter pencil for the numbers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nuán nuǎn. Affectionate reduplicated verb (暖暖身子 'warm yourself up').

examples.text: 早上好！在楼上就闻到暖暖的肉桂香味了！
examples.trans: Good morning! All the way upstairs I smelled warm cinnamon!

examples.text: 先喝碗热汤暖暖手和胃吧。
examples.trans: Drink a bowl of hot soup first to warm up.

meanings.en: someone; somebody; there is someone who
meanings.note: Pronounced yǒurén; existential-indefinite expression introducing an unspecified person as the agent of the following verb, or indicating that a room/seat is occupied.

examples.text: 尹正宇来不了这边，当然是有人泄露了消息。
examples.trans: Yin Zhengyu cannot come to our side; obviously someone leaked the news.

examples.text: 要不是有人爆了照片，我估计两天都撑不住。
examples.trans: Had someone not leaked that photo, I reckon it would not have lasted two days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìng rén. Combines 杏 ('apricot/almond') + 仁 ('nut kernel').

examples.text: 小美端来了一盘刚出炉的温热杏仁饼干。
examples.trans: Mei brought over a plate of warm almond biscuits fresh from the oven.

examples.text: 用杏仁粉做的柠檬挞底吃起来特别香酥。
examples.trans: A lemon tart crust made with ground almonds tastes wonderfully crisp and nutty.

meanings.en: birch timber; pale fine-grained birch wood
meanings.note: Pinyin: huà mù. Prized for smooth, splinter-free wooden clothespins, dowels, and small craft items.

examples.text: 周经理，等一下——你看这原色桦木做得多光滑、多干净！
examples.trans: Hold on a second, Zhou—look how smooth and clean this natural birch wood is!

examples.text: 再低头看餐桌：二十八条亚麻餐巾全被编好号的桦木夹咬得死死的！
examples.trans: And look down at the tables: all twenty-eight linen napkins are clamped tight by numbered birch pins!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个橙皮 ('a 橙皮').

examples.text: 我有一个橙皮。
examples.trans: I have a 橙皮.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的橙皮。
examples.trans: This is a very good 橙皮.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tāng. Measure word (量词): 碗 (wǎn), e.g. 一碗汤 ('a bowl of soup').

examples.text: 先生，给您干毛巾擦外套，还有一碗热汤。
examples.trans: Sir, here is a dry towel to wipe your coat, plus a bowl of hot soup.

examples.text: 热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

related.gloss: a bowl of soup (measure word 碗)

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi. Short form of 没有; negates 有 and past/completed actions (没锁 'isn't locked / didn't lock').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

沾.gloss: touch upon, have to do with; moisten

meanings.en: touch upon, have to do with; moisten
meanings.note: Verb zhān ('have contact with, touch').

examples.text: 不靠谱这三个字跟他永远沾不上边。
examples.trans: The word unreliable never comes anywhere near describing him.

examples.text: 为了保护嗓子，演出前一周她滴酒不沾。
examples.trans: To protect her voice, she touches zero alcohol the week before singing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāng guǒ. Measure word: 颗 (kē) for a single berry, e.g. 一颗红浆果 ('a red berry').

examples.text: 搭档，趁浆果蛋糕在树荫下放凉，咱们从头再来一遍！
examples.trans: Partner, let us take it from the top one more time while those berry cakes cool in the shade!

examples.text: 小美一早就挑了最新鲜的浆果，准备烤给大家配红茶吃。
examples.trans: First thing in the morning Mei picked the freshest berries to bake for everyone with black tea.

meanings.note: In 全清, means background/account checks came back 100% clean.

examples.text: 所有嘉宾的背景核查都已经是全清状态。
examples.trans: Background checks on every guest came back completely clean.

examples.text: 清晨的空气格外清，让人精神一振。
examples.trans: Morning air is extra clear and refreshing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎn. Describes a full cup or a fully booked hotel.

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

examples.text: 啊……下这么大的雨，车站附近酒店全满了。
examples.trans: Ah... in rain this heavy, every hotel near the station was full.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng long. Measure word (量词): 盏 (zhǎn), e.g. 一盏灯笼 ('a lantern').

examples.text: 老陈，你在为中午挂纸灯笼吗？
examples.trans: Chen, are you hanging those paper lanterns for noon?

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tàn bǐ. Measure word (量词): 支 (zhī), e.g. 一支炭笔 ('a charcoal stick/pencil'). Joins 炭 ('charcoal') + 笔 ('pen/brush').

examples.text: 慢慢展开画纸，免得上面的炭笔线条蹭花了。
examples.trans: Unfold the drawing paper slowly so the charcoal lines on it do not smudge.

examples.text: 这位制图员只用一支炭笔，就把五个朋友画得活灵活现。
examples.trans: With just a single stick of charcoal, the mapmaker sketched all five friends full of life.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn. Marks hours on the clock (八点 'eight o'clock') or 'a bit' (一点).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hōng bèi shī. Measure word: 位 (wèi) politely or 名 (míng), e.g. 一位烘焙师 ('a baker').

examples.text: 三十个夏天后的烘焙师值得一张不晕墨、也不沾菜汤的方子！
examples.trans: Bakers thirty summers from tonight deserve a recipe with zero smudged ink and zero soup drips!

examples.text: 老顾客总说小美是梧桐巷最细心的烘焙师，甜度拿捏得刚刚好。
examples.trans: Regulars always call Mei the most thoughtful baker on Wutong Lane, getting the sweetness just right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tián. Describes sweet pastries, fruit, or tea with honey.

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

examples.text: 咸黄油能配甜草莓果酱吗？
examples.trans: Can salted butter go with sweet strawberry jam?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng. Works as main verb ('use a key') or preposition ('with/using').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huà. Used for drawing blueprints or painting signs.

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

examples.text: 门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
examples.trans: Only a golden key painted above the door. Show the clerk the old valve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liú. Used for leaving a note/keepsake, saving food, or staying on (留下来).

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bái. Describes white paper, sugar, or tablecloths.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: de shí hou. High-frequency temporal frame placed at the end of a verb or clause to mean 'when / while ...' (往下迈的时候 'when stepping down').

examples.text: 小美够最上面那层架子的时候，小晴赶紧上前扶住了木凳。
examples.trans: While Mei was reaching for the top shelf, Qing hurried over to steady the wooden stool.

examples.text: 我擦厨房台面的时候，罐子底下的纸标签不小心被水弄湿了。
examples.trans: When I was wiping the kitchen counter, the paper labels under the jars got damp.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Single-character bound/free noun for small boxes (木盒 'wooden box', 盒子 'box'); also a measure word ('a box of').

examples.text: 雪松木盒里整齐地放着一叠旧明信片。
examples.trans: A stack of old postcards sits neatly inside the cedar box.

examples.text: 小晴买了一盒彩色粉笔写咖啡馆黑板。
examples.trans: Qing bought a box of coloured chalk to write on the café blackboard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个盒子 ('a small box').

examples.text: 搬家公司清空房子之前，我从阁楼架子救下了这个盒子。
examples.trans: Before the movers cleared the house, I saved this box from the attic shelf.

examples.text: 这个小木头盒子装的是老照片。
examples.trans: This little wooden box holds old photographs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gài zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个木头盖子 ('a wooden lid').

examples.text: 开了！老陈，快打开木头盖子！
examples.trans: It's open! Chen, quick, lift the wooden lid!

examples.text: 盖子要小心一点——它已经关了几十年了。
examples.trans: Careful with the lid—it has been closed for decades.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn. As a verb, 'stand' (站在旁边); as a noun, 'station/stop' (火车站).

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you standing beside the little stone fountain?

meanings.note: Pinyin: duān. Specifically describes carrying dishes, soup, or tea level in the hands.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 她端着一盘热面包走出来。
examples.trans: She walked out carrying a tray of warm bread.

meanings.note: Verb/noun xiào ('smile, laugh').

examples.text: 你看着我的笔记笑什么？
examples.trans: Why are you smiling at my notes?

examples.text: 听到这个好消息，大家都开心地笑了。
examples.trans: Hearing the good news, everyone smiled happily.

meanings.note: Ordinal numeral dìsān ('third').

examples.text: 接下来介绍第三季的全面改版计划。
examples.trans: Next we present the full overhaul plan for Season Three.

examples.text: 今晚的第三位竞演歌手即将登台演唱。
examples.trans: Tonight's third competing singer is about to take the stage.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng. Everyday verb for waiting (等一下 'wait a moment').

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiān. Used for signing names, contracts, or delivery slips.

examples.text: 哈！你怕签了名字，倔脾气大哥就不出门了！
examples.trans: Aha! You feared that if you signed your name, stubborn big brother would stay home!

examples.text: 请在这份收据下面签上名字。
examples.trans: Please sign your name at the bottom of this receipt.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a adj used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个粗。
examples.trans: I have a 粗.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的粗。
examples.trans: This is a very good 粗.

examples.text: 上个月你三天绕地球飞了一整圈，回来开电话会议，中文英文一个字没错过。
examples.trans: Last month you flew around the globe in three days and took a bilingual conference call without missing a single word!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo chén. Affectionate respectful name for Courtyard Inn's handyman.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 谢谢老陈。里面的木头小火车看着很珍贵。
examples.trans: Thank you, Chen. The little wooden train inside looked very precious.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bèi miàn. Measure word (量词): 面 (miàn), e.g. 纸张背面 ('the back of a sheet').

examples.text: 等等——通知背面回形针还别着第二页折起来的纸……
examples.trans: Wait—clipped to the back of the notice is a folded second page...

examples.text: 收据背面写着五金店的联系电话。
examples.trans: The hardware store's phone number is written on the back of the receipt.

related.gloss: the back of a sheet (measure word 面)

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāo dài. Compound 胶 ('glue/rubber') + 带 ('tape/ribbon'). Measure word: 卷 (juǎn, 'roll').

examples.text: 老陈用黑胶带把电线接头一圈一圈包紧。
examples.trans: Chen wrapped the wire splice tightly turn by turn with black tape.

examples.text: 打包瓷器的时候，箱子外面要多贴两道胶带。
examples.trans: When packing crockery, put a couple of extra strips of tape around the outside of the box.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯茶 ('a cup of tea').

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!

related.gloss: a cup of tea (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: cài — general term for prepared dishes in a meal or leafy vegetables (measure word 道 dào or 盘 pán for dishes)
colloquial slang in 是某人的菜, meaning someone or something that suits one's personal or romantic taste

examples.text: 这个是你的菜吧？不好意思了！
examples.trans: This one is your type, right? Now you are embarrassed!

examples.text: 你觉得他们家菜还合口吧？
examples.trans: Do the dishes at this place suit your taste?

meanings.en: mint leaves (fresh or dried for tea and aroma)
meanings.note: Pinyin: bò hé yè. Note bò rather than báo in 薄荷. Measure word: 片 (piàn) for a single leaf.

examples.text: 角落里再塞一小包晒干的院子薄荷叶，留点清香。
examples.trans: Tuck a small packet of dried courtyard mint leaves into the corner for a fresh scent.

examples.text: 小美往热茶壶里丢了几片新鲜薄荷叶，端出来时满院清凉。
examples.trans: Mei dropped a few fresh mint leaves into the hot teapot, bringing a crisp cool scent into the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dàn gāo. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块蛋糕 ('a piece of cake').

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 十一点二十分。小美，蛋糕好了吗？
examples.trans: Eleven twenty. Mei, is the cake ready?

related.gloss: a piece of cake (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng mì. Measure word (量词): 勺, e.g. 一勺蜂蜜 ('a spoonful of honey').

examples.text: 宋老师，给您热薄荷茶和蜂蜜。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, here is hot mint tea and honey for you.

examples.text: 太明智了！旁边要配蜂蜜还是苹果果酱？
examples.trans: Wise choice! Would you like honey or apple jam on the side?

related.gloss: a spoonful of honey (measure word 勺)

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng là. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài) or 层 (céng). Joins 蜂 ('bee') + 蜡 ('wax').

examples.text: 信封的开口处滴着一圈红色的封印蜂蜡。
examples.trans: The opening of the envelope is dripped with a ring of red sealing beeswax.

examples.text: 老陈用一块天然蜂蜡仔细打磨着木雕。
examples.trans: Chen carefully polished the wood carving with a piece of natural beeswax.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī jiā. Measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī), e.g. 二十八个桦木衣夹 ('twenty-eight birch clothespins').

examples.text: 走，下楼吧——前台还有三十个木衣夹等着小晴呢。
examples.trans: Come on downstairs—I have thirty wooden clothespins waiting for Qing at the front desk.

examples.text: 小晴把九号衣夹放进铁盒前，先让院子里的每个人都在背面签了名。
examples.trans: Before placing clothespin number nine into the tin box, Qing had everyone in the courtyard sign its back.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo luò. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个角落 ('a corner').

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 为小院客栈干杯——成都最热闹的安静角落！
examples.trans: Cheers to Courtyard Inn—the liveliest quiet corner in Chengdu!

meanings.note: Pinyin: chèn. Introduces a favorable moment before it passes (趁热吃 'eat while it's hot').

examples.text: 趁着阳光亮，我能再看看那张小纸牌吗？
examples.trans: While the sunlight is bright, may I look at that small paper tag again?

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhóu. Refers to a cylindrical pivot pin, hinge pin (合页轴), or axle around which a part turns.

examples.text: 老陈在每个生锈的合页轴上都滴了两滴机油。
examples.trans: Chen put two drops of lubricating oil on every rusty hinge pin.

examples.text: 门扇转动不顺的时候，擦干净合页轴就会好很多。
examples.trans: When a door swings stiffly, wiping the hinge pin clean helps a lot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一边 ('one side').

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

examples.text: 快坐在向阳窗户边，宋老师！先别急着上楼！
examples.trans: Sit right down by the sunny window, Teacher Song! No rush to go back upstairs yet!

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò. Read neutral-tone guo after a verb for 'have ever done' (见过); read guò as a verb meaning 'cross/pass' (过河 'cross the river').

examples.text: 早跟你说过，那个平板是个坑。
examples.trans: Told you before, that tablet is a trap.

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

examples.text: 我们不用电脑，一直用这个大纸本子记账。
examples.trans: We do not use a computer; we always use this big paper ledger to keep accounts.

examples.text: 这个木头小火车是老木匠专门为孩子们做的礼物。
examples.trans: This little wooden train is a gift made specially for the children by the old carpenter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèr. Spoken variant of 这里 ('here').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

examples.text: 这是什么套啊？
examples.trans: What kind of setup?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn. Movement into an enclosed space (请进 'come in!', 倒进 'pour into').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn lái. Friendly invitation 请进来 ('please come in').

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

examples.text: 晚上好！先生，快进来避避雨吧。
examples.trans: Good evening! Sir, come inside quickly out of the rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén kǒu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 大门口 ('at the doorway').

examples.text: 等等——那星期一晚上门口台阶……第二个蓝箱子……
examples.trans: Wait—then Monday night on our front step... the second blue suitcase...

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？
examples.trans: Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wén. Everyday verb for smelling aromas (闻到香味 'smell a fragrance').

examples.text: 早上好！在楼上就闻到暖暖的肉桂香味了！
examples.trans: Good morning! All the way upstairs I smelled warm cinnamon!

examples.text: 一进门就闻到了烤面包的香味。
examples.trans: Right on stepping inside, I smelled baking bread.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.en: dark gray-blue stone paving slab; courtyard flagstone
meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng shí bǎn. Measure word: 块 (kuài), e.g. 第三块青石板 ('the third flagstone').

examples.text: 太精彩了！听听这二十八位邻里在院子青石板上响起的掌声吧——满院子都在鼓掌！
examples.trans: Bravo! Listen to the applause rising from all twenty-eight neighbors across the courtyard flagstones!

examples.text: 梧桐巷下过雨以后，湿润的青石板把红灯笼的影子映得亮晶晶的。
examples.trans: After rain on Wutong Lane, the damp flagstones reflect the red lanterns in a soft shimmer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāng. Puts warm praise on fragrant tea/bread and even deep, restful sleep (睡得香).

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

examples.text: 这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
examples.trans: Best sleep I have had all month, and the shower water was wonderfully hot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huáng. Describes yellow flowers, brass, or butter.

examples.text: 篮子里正躺着六个黄柠檬呢——厨房就等今天了！
examples.trans: Six yellow lemons are sitting in my basket right now—this kitchen was waiting for today!

examples.text: 秋天到了，院子里的树叶黄了。
examples.trans: Autumn has arrived, and the courtyard leaves have turned yellow.
